symptom: Mobile visitors can remain on the branded loading skeleton or receive an availability retry box in the spa, holiday and near-vacation rails.
production_observations: All five public /api/vii/home-deals period requests returned HTTP 503 supplier_unavailable.
The prior browser timeout fix only reuses an accepted value from the same browser session.
A first visitor has no session value, so a server cold miss still becomes an empty failure state.
root_cause: The system had a bounded browser request but no truthful immediate server fallback for a cold or missing durable availability snapshot.
repair: Return approved catalog cards immediately, schedule the exact live refresh in the request background, and replace catalog cards with verified dated offers when the durable snapshot becomes available.
truth_boundary: Catalog fallback contains no invented dated availability. Booking and detail confirmation remain live.
